title: The Official Ybor City Ghost Tour
includes: EMF meters, dousing rods, speaker box, laser grid, motion sensors and more
Access to several haunted spots exclusively to this tour such as Jose Marti Park and The Cuban Club
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Do you have what it takes to enter the most haunted buildings in Ybor City? Award winning guides have the keys to places of pilgrimage for Ghost Hunters around the globe. Hear the fascinating stories of all the unique characters and tragedies of Ybor City. Then come face to face with them as you explore their dwellings.
